title: 二叉树的最大深度
statement:
给定二叉树的根节点 root，返回它的最大深度，即从根节点到最远叶子节点的路径上的节点个数。空树深度为 0。

节点定义：struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }。输入中的树为 LeetCode 层序表示，null 表示空位。

en.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
en.statement:
Given the root of a binary tree, return its maximum depth, i.e. the number of nodes on the path from the root to the farthest leaf. An empty tree has depth 0.

Node definition: struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }. The input tree uses LeetCode level-order representation, with null marking empty positions.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^4]; -100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

complexity.space: Recursive DFS: O(h) recursion stack; BFS: O(w) queue (w is the maximum level width). Both O(n) in the worst case.
complexity.notes: n is the number of nodes and h is the tree height. The largest local tests are a 10^4-node single chain (recursion depth 10^4, fine with the default stack) and a random 10^4-node tree.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is m (the number of level-order tokens, 0 for an empty tree); line 2 has m tokens (integers or null), the tree's LeetCode level-order representation. stdout: one integer, the maximum depth.

constraints: 节点数在 [0, 10^4] 范围内；-100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

complexity.space: 递归 DFS 为 O(h) 递归栈；BFS 为 O(w) 队列（w 为最大层宽）。最坏均为 O(n)。
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为节点数，h 为树高。本地最大测试为 10^4 个节点的单链（递归深度 10^4，默认栈可承受）与 10^4 个节点的随机树。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 m（层序 token 数，空树为 0）；第二行 m 个 token（整数或 null），为树的 LeetCode 层序表示。stdout：一个整数，最大深度。
